rows.label: Default Waste Factor (%)
rows.description: Default waste percentage for material estimates

rows.label: Show Itemized Pricing
rows.description: When enabled, the estimate shows a full line-item breakdown. When disabled, only the grand total is shown.

rows.label: Discount Enabled
rows.description: Toggle to show/hide the discount button on the estimate

rows.label: Discount Name
rows.description: The label shown on the estimate for this discount (e.g. "Spring Promo", "Veteran Discount")

rows.label: Discount Type
rows.description: Type of discount: "percent" for percentage off, "flat" for a fixed dollar amount

rows.label: Discount Amount
rows.description: Discount value: percentage (0-100) if type is "percent", or dollar amount if type is "flat"

rows.label: Show Pricing on Estimate
rows.description: When disabled, the estimate shows only a scope of work without any dollar amounts
